 Alexander Skarsgard loves to have fun with fashion and he stepped out in a very unique outfit this week!
 The 50-year-old actor was seen arriving for a Wicker screening in a curly gray wig on Tuesday afternoon (October 20) at the Landmark Sunset theater in Los Angeles. 
 Alexander completed his outfit with black and white zebra-striped short shorts and a black jacket that was all zipped up. 
 15 
 15 
 Was Alexander Skarsgard’s look a tribute to Olivia Colman?
 Some are speculating that Alexander was paying tribute to his Wicker co-star Olivia Colman by wearing the wig. 
 Later that evening, Alexander wore a custom shirt to the premiere of their movie and it featured her face on it!
 The actor recently wore a “lick my worm” t-shirt at the NYC screening and wore transparent shoes with a gold suit at the London screening. 
 15 
 What is Wicker about?
 An audacious comedic fable about sex, marriage, and the absurdities of social convention, WICKER tells the wholly original love story of an ostracized fisherwoman ( Colman ) who commissions a husband to be made by the local basketmaker ( Peter Dinklage ). When her wicker husband ( Skarsgård ) proves more spectacular than she ever imagined, his soulful spirit and unique prowess awaken something inside her, setting off a wave of jealousy, fascination, and upheaval that threatens the very fabric of village life.
 Wicker is slated to hit theaters THIS Friday (October 23). Check out the trailer here!
